subject: Artifact inventory & retention plan — Redwood <> ClearBridge
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Miller <susan.miller@clearbridge-payments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Artifact inventory & retention plan — Redwood <> ClearBridge

Susan — great conversation this morning. Quick written recap and next steps so we’re aligned.

Summary of pain and goals you shared:
- Auditability: you need 13 months of tamper-evident audit logs for model inference and admin actions (for PCI/third-party audits).
- Data residency/segmentation: logs and retained artifacts must be stored in your US-only project and not accessible by other tenants.
- Contractual guarantees: ClearBridge requires SOC 2 Type II report, proof of recent pen test, and a DPA with explicit retention and deletion timelines.
- For privacy: concerns about KV cache and prompt retention — you want a concrete config and proof that short-lived caches are not persisted beyond request TTL.

What Redwood proposed during call (recap):
- We can provide: SOC 2 summary + attestation (most recent period), pen test summary + remediation timeline, audit-log retention configuration (adjustable per-customer), and a DPA template that includes retention/deletion clauses and KMS integrations.
- Short-term mitigation: enable dedicated log export to your S3 bucket (US region) and configure 13-month lifecycle.

Immediate next steps (action owners & timing):
1) Attachments we promised — I’m sending our checklist and an ask-list below. (Attachment: Redwood-Artifact-Checklist-v1.pdf) — Hannah — today
2) ClearBridge to send SOC 2 summary + pen test contact if you want us to route to infosec (Susan) — requested by EOD Wed (5/5)
3) Internal: Ben and Karthik to validate export config options (S3 export, encryption, separation) and confirm how we prove deletion on request — due Tue (5/4)
4) Monica to prepare a short runbook showing how we collect the artifacts for legal review (sample evidence list + timestamps) — due Thu (5/6)

Attachment: Redwood-Artifact-Checklist-v1.pdf (attachment stub — checklist of artifacts we can produce: SOC 2 report reference, pen test summary, Syslog exports, audit-log delivery package, deletion confirmations, DPA template).

If that lines up, I’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up for next week (preferred Tues/Wed) with your security and legal.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---

Hannah — thanks for the clear recap. Couple quick notes:
- Confirmed: 13 months for audit logs is our baseline; if we go to SOC-2+ we may ask for 24 months but let’s start with 13.
- I’m attaching a compressed SOC2 executive summary and a redacted pen test cover note. (Attachment: ClearBridge_SOC2-Summary.pdf)
- Legal wants the DPA template before our procurement kickoff. It should include explicit clauses about retention windows, deletion procedures, and proof-of-deletion artifacts.

We’ll aim to get our pen-test vendor contact to you if you want direct sync; otherwise I can drop the vendor name in an email.

Two asks for Redwood:
1) Sample evidence packet (what exactly will you provide?)
2) Quick note on KV cache behavior and whether prompt text can be guaranteed ephemeral (non-persistent) if we request that configuration.

Happy to be on a follow-up next Tue 5/4 at 10:00am PT if that works for your team.

—Susan
Susan Miller
VP Product, ClearBridge Payments

Ben: can you validate S3 export + lifecycle + encryption options for a US-only tenant and confirm what we can ship as proof-of-deletion? (Do we produce object-level delete receipts or signed timestamps?)

Monica: please start a short evidence runbook (1 pager) showing how we will assemble artifacts for legal review — include timestamps and redaction notes.

Goal: have the three items to Hannah by EOD Tuesday 5/4 so we can confirm the Tue 10am PT slot with Susan. If any blockers, flag here and I’ll escalate.

Thanks — Hannah

Copying the ask list into my tracker and starting infra check now. Quick notes:
- S3 export: we can provision a dedicated export pipeline to a customer-owned S3 (US-only) with SSE-KMS. Export contains audit-log bundles (inference requests metadata, admin events) and we can set a 13-month lifecycle policy on the bucket. Proof-of-deletion: we can provide signed object lifecycle events and an MD5 + timestamp manifest per delivery.
- KV cache: current default is ephemeral in-memory only; we persist a short-term in-memory cache for performance but do not write prompt texts to disk unless explicitly enabled. For ClearBridge we can enforce a strictly non-persistent KV mode and provide a short technical note and a sample config.
- Pen test/attestation: we can share redacted pen test summary and SOC 2 reference; legal should review DPA template for the deletion clause language.

I’ll drop the config notes + sample manifest into the shared HubSpot ticket and attach them to the evidence packet by EOD Tue 5/4.

—Ben
